purpose: This module owns the content-free run row and its state machine. It validates identifiers and vocabulary, performs account-scoped PostgreSQL operations, prevents illegal races, tracks progress counters, and exposes run-level operations to the router.
summary: Stores device runs and enforces their atomic lifecycle and per-device concurrency rules.
